content.text: Which layer do you want to turn or grow from somewhere other than its middle, and where should it turn from: a corner, an edge, or the middle? If nothing comes to mind, Door could swing from the middle of its left edge. Want to try that one?
Sled will turn from the middle of its left edge. Sled has one Position key, at 3.7 s. Put the playhead right on that key so the pivot change goes into it, and tell me when it's there.

Sled stays put at 0 s, but at 3.7 s it now sits to the right of where it was. Pan Behind changed Position only where the playhead was, and added a key there. Edit > Undo, put the playhead right on Sled's key at 3.7 s, and drag again.

Say done when it's there.
